mapper.select: select a.content_hash as contentHash, count(*) as aliasCount, coalesce(sum(a.size), 0) as aliasBytes from a where exists (select 1 from m where m.content_hash = a.content_hash) group by a.content_hash order by aliasBytes desc, a.content_hash asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from ( select a.content_hash from a where exists (select 1 from m where m.content_hash = a.content_hash) group by a.content_hash ) t
select id as id, content_hash as contentHash, rel_path as relPath, root_id as rootId, size as size from where content_hash = #{contentHash} order by id asc
select id as id, content_hash as contentHash, rel_path as relPath, root_id as rootId, size as size from where id = #{id}

choose.when: select id as id, rel_path as relPath, size as size, root_id as rootId, content_hash as contentHash from media_video where content_hash = #{contentHash} order by hidden asc, id asc limit 1
choose.otherwise: select id as id, rel_path as relPath, bytes as size, root_id as rootId, content_hash as contentHash from media_photo where content_hash = #{contentHash} order by hidden asc, id asc limit 1
